export const meta = {
  name: "sample-sweep",
  description: "Smallest Claude Workflow shape the converter must handle",
  whenToUse: "Fixture only.",
  phases: [{ title: "Bootstrap", detail: "read inputs" }],
};

const RESULT_SCHEMA = {
  type: "object",
  required: ["status"],
  properties: {
    status: { type: "string", enum: ["ok", "abort"], description: "outcome" },
  },
};

const input = args ?? {};
phase("Bootstrap");
log("starting");

const first = await agent(`Do the thing with ${input.topic}.`, {
  agentType: "bg-fix",
  phase: "Bootstrap",
  label: "first",
  schema: RESULT_SCHEMA,
});

const pair = await parallel([
  () => agent("Second A", { agentType: "readonly-reviewer", phase: "Bootstrap", label: "a", schema: RESULT_SCHEMA }),
  () => agent("Second B", { label: "b" }),
]);

return { first, pair };
